attempts.raw: {"risk": 2, "reason": "Fixes a bug by extracting the actual attribute value instead of the TagHelperAttribute object's ToString(), which previously would have produced incorrect strings like 'name=\"value\"' or default type names for cache-id/context/tag/duration/alternate/wrapper attributes—this is a low-risk, well-scoped bugfix but changes runtime behavior of tag helper attribute parsing used across many views."

{"risk": 2, "reason": "Fixes a bug where TagHelperAttribute (which previously ToString'd to a wrapper description) is now correctly unwrapped via .Value before Convert.ToString, changing behavior for cache-id/context/tag/duration/id/alternate/wrapper attributes on shape tag helpers, but this is a narrow, well-contained fix that should only correct previously-broken attribute parsing rather than introduce new breakage."}

reason: Fixes a bug where TagHelperAttribute (which previously ToString'd to a wrapper description) is now correctly unwrapped via .Value before Convert.ToString, changing behavior for cache-id/context/tag/duration/id/alternate/wrapper attributes on shape tag helpers, but this is a narrow, well-contained fix that should only correct previously-broken attribute parsing rather than introduce new breakage.
